units: <cite ref="Eruvin 26a:4">Erub. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון דלצ׳ עבידא</he> because the partition is made merely for the sake of privacy (not permanent).
<cite ref="Berakhot 62a:7">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ ושתיקותא</he> decency (in uncovering one’s self for a human need) and silence.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 82a:13">B. Kam. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>משום צ׳</he> as a matter of chastity (v. <cite ref="O00742"><he>סִינָר</he></cite>); a. e.
